name: Automate the Schwab RPS ingest (schwab/silver/rps has no automated producer -- it is a human running two scripts against Andrew's OneDrive)
description:
Registered 2026-07-09 by 2.0.0_SA_COO at CTO's direction (1.0.0_SA_CTO 214528Z). DEFERRED BY ANDREW'S OWN ORDERING -- explicitly sequenced AFTER Inflection. Do not start.

THE FINDING: `s3://opal-data-bd/schwab/silver/rps/` last partition = `date=20260706`, written 2026-07-07T10:44:43Z. Nothing since. `sync_schwab_onedrive_to_s3.py` documents the mechanism in its own docstring: the Schwab SI2 Desktop client delivers per-account CRS*.{ext} files to a locally-configured Destination folder; the canonical 49F location is `C:\Users\AndrewBerman\OneDrive - Opal Capital\Documents\Schwab Data Delivery\08242234\`. Usage is `python sync_schwab_onedrive_to_s3.py --upload` and THEN `convert_schwab_rps_to_parquet.py`. A human runs both.

WHY IT MATTERS: this is the root cause of the MDPF Inflection-AUM freeze. MDPF's convergence gate is AND-composed, so a stale 49F custody feed defers the whole chain -- Inflection itself is fresh every day (the gate's own log: `inflection: fresh=true, as_of=2026-07-09`). Andrew, verbatim: "49 Financial should not hold up MDPF, that is nonsensical." The contract agrees (SS3.5-decision-iv adopted per-partner roll-forward); the gate is stricter than the contract it implements.

AND THE GATE FIX ALONE IS NOT SAFE. 49F's `non_model_aua` is a RESIDUAL whose minuend (RPS custody) is frozen and whose subtrahend (SmartX `model_aua`) is fresh. Served, to the cent: `partner_custody_total` = 1,621,251,574.22 on 07-06, 07-07 AND 07-08, while `model_aua` fell $10,474,162.28 and the plug rose by EXACTLY that. Un-gating alone resumes that corruption daily instead of never; the deferred chain is the only thing currently holding it still (NEVER#6 logic applied to a data path). Hence the 0.6.0 per-partner-gate + 0.4.0 WS-E-guard CO-ACTIVATION: neither lands alone.

CAVEAT, CARRIED AS THE ROW'S OWN TEXT AND BINDING ON WHOEVER PICKS THIS UP (CTO, verbatim, flagging his own negative): "`aws events list-rules` surfaces only `canonical-schwab-si2-download-schedule` (a different tree), and `comp-grep` over `infra/` finds no Lambda writer. CAVEAT, and hold me to it: that negative is a claim about my query -- I matched EventBridge rule *names* on `rps`/`schwab`. A rule named otherwise would not have surfaced. STRONGLY SUPPORTED, not proven. Have someone confirm before anyone writes 'there is no producer' in a doc."

NOBODY WRITES "there is no automated producer" AS FACT until that confirmation lands. Rule 22: a causal claim is a HYPOTHESIS until source/graph-confirmed; "proof / provably / root cause / definitively" are reserved words. The FIRST deliverable of this project is the confirming read (dataflow/graph, not a name-matched grep), not the automation.

SETTLED AND NOT TO BE RE-OPENED: the 06-26 -> 07-01 six-day MDPF hole is NOT this. CTO initially attributed it to the same manual feed, then retracted himself within 20 minutes, before any dispatch: RPS wrote on 06-26, 06-29, 06-30, 07-01 and 07-02 -- every trading day across the hole -- and the RPS repoint did not land until 2026-07-01T21:14:05Z, AFTER it. Throughout that hole the gate was keyed on `silver/{allocations,fees}` and had never heard of RPS; a feed the gate was not reading cannot have caused a defer. 0.5.0_AE_OpalETL's `silver/fees` attribution STANDS on its own evidence. Two silences separated by a repoint. Distinct cause, distinct window, distinct gate configuration.
phase: REGISTERED, NOT STARTED. Andrew-ordered AFTER Inflection. Deliverable 1 = confirm the no-automated-producer negative by dataflow read (CTO's caveat above), NOT by a rule-name grep. Deliverable 2 = the automation itself. Nothing begins until Andrew's Inflection ordering clears.
